name: Uther's Statue in Uther's Tomb is a quest target without a model
contract: The Ascension client crashes in GetCollisionFacets on utherstatue.m2 when gameobject 181653
(Uther's Statue, spawn 45493) is shown with display 6815. The tomb already draws the statue, so
rev_20261103_20_coa_uther_statue_crash gives the gameobject display 0. The spawn must stay in the
world, because quest 9444 (Defiling Uther's Tomb) uses it as the target of spell 30098.

steps.label: Uther's Statue is still spawned for quest 9444
and it has no model for the client to build a collision for
